name: GameChanger Wallet
description_short: Non-custodial web meta wallet for Cardano.
description_long: Non-custodial web light wallet for Cardano, running on desktop and mobile without an extension. Works as a meta wallet: it can import or connect seed phrases, burner wallets, encrypted QR gift wallets, Ledger and Trezor hardware wallets, any CIP-30 browser extension wallet, and shared treasuries at script addresses. Its Universal Dapp Connector lets dapps, devices, and users communicate with the wallet through URLs, QR codes, and intents rather than a browser extension API, with support for multisig, multi-account, and multi-transaction flows. Includes GCScript, a domain-specific language for building transactions, a built-in Playground IDE, and GCFS for storing dapp code on-chain. Open source under MIT.
